annotations.title: Listing facts for a Hawaiʻi lot

description: Writes nothing itself; gives the facts an agent needs to write or check a Hawaiʻi listing, by TMK or address: listing description lot facts, what to tell buyers or disclose about the lot (flood zone, tsunami zone, sea level rise, landslide, Special Management Area, shoreline, cesspool or sewer, vacation rental standing), zoning and whether an ADU or second dwelling is listed in the code, lot size as mapped, and water and sewer service. Each line is a plain sentence with its official county, State or federal source link, ready to quote. Use it for MLS remarks, buyer emails, social posts and seller prep. Public records with sources, not legal advice, a survey or a permit.

address.description: Or a Hawaiʻi street address, e.g. 4-1345 Kuhio Hwy, Kapaa

tmk.description: Hawaiʻi Tax Map Key, 9 digits, dashes optional, e.g. 4-4-2-016-063
